rationale: Price is at 98.2% of today's range and within 0.13% of the session high after a large gap-up of 4.18%, suggesting the move is already extended with limited upside reward relative to risk. Entering long here chases a near-exhausted move, while entering short against strong momentum and elevated relative volume (3.59x) with price pressing new highs offers poor risk/reward as well. The wide bid-ask spread of 18 bps adds friction, and with 207 minutes remaining there is no compelling asymmetric setup in either direction at this moment.
